actions.action: Check the soil moisture before watering
Water at the base of the plant when dry, up to 3 times a week
Move the plant to shade or a spot with morning sun and afternoon shade

verdict.reason: The top comment blames overwatering, and the sun stress and thirst diagnosis and fix (shade, water when dry) only appear in a later comment, so both diagnosis and advice are partial; watering is guarded by soil checks, so it is not harmful.
